justification: Changes the one-time Copernicus ingest and re-loads one production row (EMSR567). Not Critical: one row, backed up, guarded by an area cap that refuses before any write. Not Minor: it changes which addresses get an EMS hit in the served flood check.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Fails if any non-flood layer (all 10 real AOI01 layer names are in the fixture ZIP) is read, if a 43,000 km2 footprint-sized extent passes, or if a refused extent reaches the insert.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Area checked against PostGIS ST_Area(geography) on the written row: 333.5 km2 vs script 333.8 km2; old row 86,348.6 km2. The independent EPSG:3577 geopandas measure gave 333.5 km2.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Red seen on the real data, not on the tests: the old code produced the live 86,348.6 km2 row (ST_Area). The new tests cannot run against the old file at all (it has no check_extent / is_observed_layer), so they were not shown red on it.

pre_impl.existing_data: copernicus_flood_events: 3 rows. EMSR567 86,349 km2 / 5 polygons; NSW-202207 410 km2; NSW-202210 842 km2. Per-layer areas measured on all 13 downloaded AOIs: imageFootprintA up to 48,392 km2, observedEventA 0.9-106 km2.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The plan said the event names were mojibake in the DB; the stored bytes are valid UTF-8 (e2 80 93, c3 b1) in the table and in all 270 saved-check copies. The garbling was console display.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new script; the existing ingest is fixed in place.
pre_impl.external_source_error: A missing ZIP (403/404) is skipped; no flood layer at all, area over 5,000 km2 or non lon/lat bounds raise ExtentRejected and nothing is committed (DELETE and INSERT share one commit).

functions.name: check_extent
functions.what: Refuses an empty, oversized or non-Australian lon/lat extent before any write.
functions.output: area of the extent in km2, or raises ExtentRejected
functions.edge_cases: Projected metres coordinates caught by the bounds check
functions.failure_mode: Refuses loudly; cannot write a bad extent

functions.name: is_observed_layer
functions.what: Allow-lists observedEventA GeoJSON by file name.
functions.input: one file name from inside a vector ZIP
functions.output: True only for an observedEventA GeoJSON file
functions.if_none: not reachable: ZipFile.namelist always gives strings
functions.failure_mode: A renamed layer gives no geometries, which check_extent then refuses

functions.name: area_km2
functions.input: a shapely polygon or multipolygon in lon/lat degrees
functions.output: area in square kilometres as a float
functions.if_none: not reachable: callers pass a checked non-empty geometry

break_it.scenario: ZIP with every real layer, footprint-sized
break_it.what_happens: Ignored: only observedEventA by name is read
No geometries; ingest raises before writing; old row kept
ExtentRejected above 5,000 km2; insert never called

verified: 10/10 new tests pass; 19/19 flood known-answer tests pass
Dry run then live write: 3,259 polygons, 333.8 km2
After write: rows over 5,000 km2 = 0, garbled names = 0, 3 rows total
Saved checks (308): EMSR567 hits 223 -> 1; signal unchanged 285, elevated->moderate 18, elevated->low 5, none raised
gaps: AOI05, AOI11, AOI12 have no DEL vector ZIP on the Copernicus server; not covered (same as before)

post_merge.action: Production row already replaced on 2026-10-28 (new id 5); backup data/db_rollback_backups/copernicus_emsr567_pre_2026-10-28T1420.json in main checkout
post_merge.db_reset: None needed: production row already replaced 2026-10-28 (id 1 -> id 5); rollback = re-insert from the backup JSON
post_merge.secrets: None: no new secrets or env vars
post_merge.manual_verify: SELECT activation_id, ST_Area(geometry::geography)/1e6 FROM copernicus_flood_events -> EMSR567 333.5, none over 5,000

The real HTTP and DB layers were exercised for real on 2026-10-28: 13 Copernicus S3 ZIPs downloaded, row written to production, then read back with PostGIS ST_Area (333.5 km2, 3,259 polygons).
